title: Holdout Juror in Lindsay Clancy’s Mistrial Highlights a Divide in America
summary: The nation’s reaction to the 11-1 deadlock that resulted in a mistrial for Lindsay Clancy was, like the jury itself, fiercely and unbridgeably divided.
